messages:
mike: Noticed weird quantile divergence after we added weighted routing. p95 in dashboard jumped ~80ms but raw post-agg samples show a smaller change. Could be an approx-quantile artifact. Anyone dug into tdigest vs exact histograms?

lorelei: We've seen tdigest compress weirdly when the distribution shifts mass between two clusters (main vs fallback). In practice p50/p95 can move differently vs exact.

mike: example: small fallback fraction with slightly higher midtail can nudge p95 in merged tdigest more than the actual per-route p95.

nina: I can run a compare across the last 2 hours. will compute exact quantiles from raw samples for routes with cnt>500 and compare against tdigest-approx at ingestion.

metrics-bot: Job 100210 submitted by nina: quantile-compare (routes). ETA ~30s.

nina: quick results: route A (main) exact p95 200ms tdigest p95 205ms cnt 41k; route B (fallback) exact p95 360ms tdigest p95 330ms cnt 3.1k; merged exact p95 220ms merged tdigest p95 260ms. so merged tdigest overshot merged exact by ~40ms.

lorelei: that pattern fits: tdigest merged online summaries can over-emphasize separated clusters if centroids compress.

janet (console): UX impact: product and oncall look at merged p95 in the endpoint view. It's easy to misinterpret. We should either (a) show per-route toggles by default when multiple routes exist, or (b) label the percentiles as "approx" and show an exact overlay for >= Xk samples. Thoughts?

mike: I'd prefer per-route toggle default for rollouts. Also add a note in tooltip: "merged quantiles are approximate; enable per-route breakdown for troubleshooting."

nina: operational ask: can we emit a flag at ingestion when we detect multi-modal latency (e.g., bimodality score > threshold) so UI can auto-surface "mixed routes detected"? I can add a job to compute a simple bimodality score per endpoint.

janet (console): good plan. I'll spec two small changes: tooltip disclaimer + auto-toggle to per-route view when fallback_fraction > 3% OR bimodal_flag=true. I'll file the ticket and attach mockups.

lorelei: longer term we should add a local histogram aggregation option in the backend for heavy endpoints — less memory than raw samples and more stable quantiles than tdigest in these scenarios.

mike: action items: nina to add bimodality job and post threshold suggestion; janet to spec UI changes; lorelei to prototype histogram aggregator. tagging @sre for visibility.

nina: posted follow-up with counts and suggested bimodal threshold (0.35 on dip test) and a query snippet:

```
-- compute per-endpoint dip test (bimodality) over 1h window
SELECT endpoint, diptest(latency_ms) AS dip, count(*)
FROM telemetry.ingress
WHERE ts BETWEEN now()-interval '1 hour' AND now()
GROUP BY endpoint
HAVING count(*) > 1000;
```

mike: perfect, thanks. I'll drop a note in the rollout runbook to check per-route p50/p95 when either fallback_fraction>3% or dip>0.3.

metrics-bot: Job 100210 completed in 28s. Results uploaded to ticket.
